title: Renewal and Nonrenewal Terms, CondoGuard HO-6
content:
Renewal figures of the CondoGuard Unit-Owners Policy by tier: when the renewal is billed, the least advance notice of nonrenewal, the paid-claims count at which a policy becomes eligible for nonrenewal and the window it is counted over, and the automatic Coverage A increase at renewal (inflation guard).

| Tier | Days before expiration the renewal is billed (calendar days) | Minimum advance notice of nonrenewal (calendar days) | Paid claims in the lookback making the policy eligible for nonrenewal | Claims lookback window (months) | Inflation guard, Coverage A increase at renewal (percent) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| CondoGuard HO-6 Named Perils Essential | 45 | 30 | 3 | 36 | 3 |
| CondoGuard HO-6 Named Perils Enhanced | 45 | 30 | 3 | 36 | 3 |
| CondoGuard HO-6 Special Essential | 45 | 30 | 3 | 36 | 3 |
| CondoGuard HO-6 Special Enhanced | 45 | 30 | 3 | 36 | 3 |
| CondoGuard HO-6 Special Premier | 45 | 30 | 3 | 36 | 4 |
| CondoGuard HO-6 Special Signature | 45 | 30 | 4 | 36 | 4 |

## Illustrations (hypothetical counts)

- On CondoGuard HO-6 Special Premier, 3 paid claims in the 36-month lookback reach the threshold of 3; 2 do not.
- On CondoGuard HO-6 Special Signature the threshold is 4, so 3 paid claims in the lookback do not reach it.
- The inflation guard is 3 percent on the first four tiers and 4 percent on CondoGuard HO-6 Special Premier and CondoGuard HO-6 Special Signature.
